proof_body:
by
  intro R _ I t h1 h2 P hP
  have hPp := hP.1.1
  have h : t.inf id ≤ P := h1 ▸ hP.1.2
  obtain ⟨J, hJ, hle⟩ := (Ideal.IsPrime.inf_le' hPp).1 h
  have hJp : J.radical.IsPrime := Ideal.isPrime_radical (h2 J hJ)
  have hIJ : I ≤ J.radical := by
    rw [← h1]
    exact (Finset.inf_le (f := id) hJ).trans Ideal.le_radical
  exact ⟨J, hJ, le_antisymm (hPp.radical_le_iff.2 hle) (hP.2 ⟨hJp, hIJ⟩ ((hPp.radical_le_iff.2 hle)))⟩
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (t : Finset (Ideal R)), t.inf id = I → (∀ J ∈ t, J.IsPrimary) → I.minimalPrimes ⊆ Ideal.radical '' (t : Set (Ideal R))
